name: Don't Peek 2018
information:
This competition is focused on the BLD, fewest moves and big cube events. **Keep in mind that you need to stay quiet during the BLD events to not disturb the competitors. If you're participating in the competition you are expected to help out with judging, scrambling, running etc. to keep the competition running smoothly.** Spectators are welcome though most of the event that are held are pretty long and boring to watch. 
  There will be a competitor limit of 40 persons and the entry fee is set to 50 SEK. Check out the other tabs for more details.
